import pathlib,subprocess,hashlib,json,base64,datetime
assert subprocess.check_output(['hostname'],text=True).strip()=='haiyue-vps'
assert pathlib.Path('/opt/cps-novel/current').resolve().name=='b378910a8ec4b78029e71ad1bac92c742efb9f5b'

info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect','cps-novel-web-1'],text=True))[0];assert info['State']['Health']['Status']=='healthy'
uid=subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','cps-novel-web-1','id','-u'],text=True).strip()

folder=pathlib.Path('/opt/cps-novel/shared/artifacts/verified/v065/phase-a-700e01cc');folder.mkdir(mode=0o700)
p=folder/'reviewed-ops.ts.txt';p.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(''));p.chmod(0o644)
subprocess.run(['docker','cp',str(p),'cps-novel-web-1:/tmp/promo-reclaim-53-reviewed-700e01cc.ts'],check=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','cps-novel-web-1','cat','/tmp/promo-reclaim-53-reviewed-700e01cc.ts'])).hexdigest()=='08cc8d899f3103f772a07c0fa52c0c4137f3f3539efb5402ff6d2bf0d6404a15'
p=folder/'capture-wrapper.ts.txt';p.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(''));p.chmod(0o644)

assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','cps-novel-web-1','cat','/tmp/promo-reclaim-capture-700e01cc.ts'])).hexdigest()=='8387e3462351b6434ddc205ac2afffdb33b6925582ef8a3a59590eae97ee76fc'

for name,target in [('baseline.json','/tmp/promo-reclaim-53-phase-a-700e01cc.json'),('report.json','/tmp/promo-reclaim-53-phase-a-700e01cc-report.json'),('remaining-48-ids.txt','/tmp/promo-reclaim-53-remaining-48-700e01cc.txt')]:
 data=subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','cps-novel-web-1','cat',target]);p=folder/name;p.write_bytes(data);p.chmod(0o600)
b=json.loads((folder/'baseline.json').read_text());r=json.loads((folder/'report.json').read_text());assert hashlib.sha256((folder/'baseline.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['baselineSha256']
